title: ID0417286-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PD 312571675/22] Engine vianeo-error code "SPD_FA1"
description:
Reported issue:  I'm contacting you because the terminal is reporting the error code "SPD_FA1 or Fuse_FC1_AC_Income" on our OCPP backend. I already had the
problem on Friday 04/04. I tested the continuity of the
control and power fuses. At first sight, the fault came from
fuse FC1.2 which seemed to have a false contact. After
restarting the terminal, the fault was no longer present and
charging on the 2 PDCs was possible.
The fault reappeared on 06/04 in the evening, although no
charge was in progress.
The fuses were working on Friday. Do you think this is
due to a hardware or software problem
Solution:

The error is seen and is going away after sometime. There is possibility of loose connection
Check for the connector and fuses of SPD.
For connector, Check for FA1 Plug - FA1:11 and FA1:12. Check if it is receiving 24V.
For Fuses, Check whether FC1.1, FC1.2 and FC1.3 has proper connection.
